questions.question: Vidura asked how Brahma created the bodies of the living entities after whose disappearance?
questions.explanation: "...please let me know how Brahma, the grandfather of the planetary inhabitants, created the bodies of the living entities from his own body and mind after the disappearance of the Supreme Personality of Godhead." (SB 3.10.1)

questions.question: Who replied to Vidura's questions, narrating that everything was in his heart?
questions.explanation: "...the great sage Maitreya Muni, thus hearing from Vidura, felt very much enlivened. Everything was in his heart, and thus he began to reply to the questions one after another." (SB 3.10.3)

questions.question: For how long did Brahma engage in penances and devotional service, as advised by the Personality of Godhead?
questions.explanation: "...Brahma thus engaged himself in penances for one hundred celestial years, as advised by the Personality of Godhead, and applied himself in devotional service to the Lord." (SB 3.10.4)

questions.question: What did Brahma do with the strong, violent wind and the water that were making the lotus tremble?

options.text: He drank the wind completely, along with the water
He stopped it with his mind
He prayed for it to stop

questions.explanation: "Long penance and transcendental knowledge of self-realization had matured Brahma in practical knowledge, and thus he drank the wind completely, along with the water." (SB 3.10.6)

questions.question: After entering the whorl of the lotus, Brahma divided it into three divisions of worlds and later into how many divisions?
questions.explanation: "...he divided it into three divisions of worlds and later into fourteen divisions." (SB 3.10.8)

questions.question: Why is Lord Brahma described as the most exalted personality in the universe?

options.text: Because of his causeless devotional service unto the Lord in mature transcendental knowledge
Because he was born from the lotus

questions.explanation: "Lord Brahma is the most exalted personality in the universe because of his causeless devotional service unto the Lord in mature transcendental knowledge." (SB 3.10.9)

questions.question: What is described as the primeval source of the interactions of the three modes of material nature?
questions.explanation: "Eternal time is the primeval source of the interactions of the three modes of material nature." (SB 3.10.11)

questions.question: Besides the nine kinds of creation, how many kinds of annihilations are there due to eternal time, the material elements and the quality of work?
questions.explanation: "There are three kinds of annihilations due to eternal time, the material elements and the quality of one's work." (SB 3.10.14)

questions.question: Of the nine creations, what is the first one?

options.text: The creation of the false ego
The creation of the mahat-tattva, or the sum total of the material ingredients
The creation of the controlling deities

questions.explanation: "Of the nine creations, the first one is the creation of the mahat-tattva, or the sum total of the material ingredients, wherein the modes interact due to the presence of the Supreme Lord." (SB 3.10.15)

questions.question: In which creation are the sense perceptions created, from which the elements are generated?
questions.explanation: "The sense perceptions are created in the third creation, and from these the elements are generated." (SB 3.10.16)

questions.question: The sixth creation is described as what?

options.text: The creation of the controlling deities
The ignorant darkness of the living entity, by which the master acts as a fool
The creation of knowledge and working capacity
The creation of the immovable entities

questions.explanation: "The sixth creation is the ignorant darkness of the living entity, by which the master acts as a fool." (SB 3.10.17)

questions.question: Brahma is described as an incarnation of which mode, having a brain like that of the Personality of Godhead in the matter of creation?
questions.explanation: "...the creations by Brahma, who is an incarnation of the mode of passion and who, in the matter of creation, has a brain like that of the Personality of Godhead." (SB 3.10.18)

questions.question: The seventh creation is that of the immovable entities, which are of how many kinds?
questions.explanation: "The seventh creation is that of the immovable entities, which are of six kinds..." (SB 3.10.19)

questions.question: The eighth creation is that of the lower species of life, numbering how many varieties?
questions.explanation: "The eighth creation is that of the lower species of life, and they are of different varieties, numbering twenty-eight." (SB 3.10.21)

questions.question: How do the lower species of the eighth creation know their desirables?
questions.explanation: "They know their desirables by smell, but are unable to remember anything within the heart." (SB 3.10.21)

questions.question: The horse, mule, ass, gaura, sarabha bison and wild cow are described as animals with how many hooves?
questions.explanation: "The horse, mule, ass, gaura, sarabha bison and wild cow all have only one hoof." (SB 3.10.23)

questions.question: The dog, jackal, tiger, monkey, elephant and others are known as panca-nakhas because they have what?
questions.explanation: "The dog, jackal, tiger, fox, cat, rabbit, sajaru, lion, monkey, elephant, tortoise, alligator, gosapa, etc., all have five nails in their claws." (SB 3.10.24)

questions.question: Which creation is that of the human beings, who are of one species and stock their eatables in the belly?
questions.explanation: "The creation of the human beings, who are of one species only and who stock their eatables in the belly, is the ninth in the rotation." (SB 3.10.26)

questions.question: In the human race, which mode is very prominent?
questions.explanation: "In the human race, the mode of passion is very prominent." (SB 3.10.26)

questions.question: The creation of the demigods, the tenth creation, is of how many varieties?
questions.explanation: "The creation of the demigods is of eight varieties..." (SB 3.10.28-29)
